text:
jordan: Heads-up — customer (FinTechX) asked us to lock POC success criteria + rough capacity/cost by EOD. Need a single page: use cases, eval prompts, timeline, token volumes, and a recommended GPU sizing/budget. Who can take the doc?
priya: I can draft the success criteria and prompt set. Could use sample traffic numbers from sales deck.
sam: I can do capacity math. quick q: is this full chat UI or document ingestion -> answers?
jordan: Mostly chat Q&A + a small ingestion pipeline (10k docs). Peak concurrent users estimated 40 during testing windows.
maria: security reviewed the questionnaire — they'll need answers on data retention & KMS. Can someone pull our default POC security notes?
kevin: I have the POC pricing template. For a 2-week POC we usually size conservative and offer burst credits. My rule-of-thumb: estimate peak RPS -> tokens per response -> provision.
priya: Draft success criteria proposal (short): 1) median latency < 400ms for 95% interactions, 2) accuracy on eval set >= 85% (we'll provide scoring prompt), 3) no PII leakage in 100 sample prompts, 4) end-to-end ingest + retrieval within 30s.
sam: For capacity: assumptions — 40 concurrent users, avg 1.2 requests/min/user during interactive tests -> ~48 req/min steady, spikes ~5x -> 240 req/min peak. Avg response tokens 220, avg prompt tokens 80 -> ~300 tokens per request. Monthly equivalent (for 2-week POC) tokens/day peak math: 240 req/min * 60 * 300 tokens = 4,320,000 tokens/hr at peak. For a 3-hour daily test window that's ~13M tokens/day peak window.
jordan: keep the math in the doc but present 3 scenarios: low/typical/peak + recommended GPU profile.
sam: GPU sizing: for this workload during POC we recommend 1 x A40 (or 1 x A100-s) for baseline if using a quantized 8-bit model variant. If they want lower latency headroom for spikes, 1 baseline + 1 warm standby (autoscale) — effectively reserve capacity equivalent to 2 GPUs but only run second during spike.
kevin: cost estimate (hosted) quick calc: assume model cost 0.0003 $/token (placeholder) -> 13M tokens/day * 0.0003 = $3,900/day during peak windows. For 2-week POC with 3 peak days/week assume blended ~ $18k tokens. Add reserved infra bump for standby GPU ~ $4k. I'll put a conservative total POC budget range: $12k–$30k depending on test intensity.
priya: security notes to include: retention = ephemeral logs deleted after 30 days, customer KMS for keys, redaction pipeline for PII, SOC2 scope. Maria, any additions?
maria: add: audit logs enabled, access control via SSO + least privilege, VPN for private deployment if they insist. Also call out HIPAA/PCI checkpoints — will need legal sign-off.
deploy-bot: build reminder: "POC-template-v3.docx" created in sales drive by kevin at 2024-10-15T14:02:10Z :clipboard:
jordan: action items: (1) priya -> compile success criteria + eval prompts (by 17:00), (2) sam -> embed capacity calc + recommended GPU options with short bullet table (by 16:30), (3) kevin -> final budget range + attach POC template (by 17:00), (4) maria -> security Q answers + required signoffs (ASAP).
kevin: I'll also include a short fallback option: reduce model size (Llama-2-mix -> 13B) and add caching for repeated Qs to cut token costs ~30%.
sam: I'll add a tiny code snippet for estimating token cost in the doc:
```
# rough cost
peak_req_min = 240
tokens_per_req = 300
peak_tokens_day = peak_req_min * 60 * tokens_per_req * 3 # 3 hours
token_price = 0.0003
cost_peak_day = peak_tokens_day * token_price
```
priya: perfect. I'll stitch this into a 1-pager and ping the customer. jordan: want me to copy the eval prompts you mentioned?
jordan: yes — include 25 gold prompts covering typical transactions, ambiguous queries, and PII attempts.
maria: I'll prepare the security appendix and flag anything requiring legal.
kevin: uploading draft POC one-pager now -> link: https://drive.redwood/poc-drafts/fintechx-onepager-v1
jordan: thanks all. we'll review tomorrow 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:
priya: noted.
kevin: done (uploaded)."
